observations: 固定化界面与过程控制是本期最清晰的共同线索：质子传递、载体表面反应性与过氧化氢供需都可能成为决定酶性能的隐藏变量。
蛋白语言模型研究完成了 236 条生成酶序列的分子动力学评估，但尚无表达、活性或底物谱实验，不能把结构稳定性等同于功能成立。
本周期未筛到足以进入精选的级联组装或融合酶新论文；相关栏目继续保留，并由经典阅读路线承接，避免用弱相关论文填充。

items.title: Protein language model-generated enzyme sequences exhibit high stability in molecular dynamics simulations
items.cn: 蛋白语言模型生成的酶序列在分子动力学模拟中表现出较高结构稳定性
items.topic: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
items.summary: Finenzyme 将 EC 号条件生成与分子动力学筛选串联，用动态结构评估补足只看序列或静态结构的生成流程。
items.why: 它给出了生成酶设计中可复用的计算筛选框架，也清楚暴露了从“结构稳定”走向“功能成立”之间仍缺少的实验环节。
items.evidence: 作者对 4 个 EC 类别的 236 个生成结构进行了总计 59 μs 的模拟；195/236（82.6%）保持持续稳定。当前证据全部来自计算，尚无表达和酶活验证。
items.audience: 蛋白语言模型、计算酶设计与虚拟筛选研究者
items.verification: DOI 与摘要页已核验；最终排版版本尚待出版方更新，更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: Finenzyme chains EC-number-conditioned generation with molecular dynamics screening, using dynamic structural assessment to complement generation pipelines that look only at sequences or static structures.
en.why: It offers a reusable computational screening framework for generative enzyme design and clearly exposes the experimental steps still missing between structural stability and functional success.
en.evidence: The authors simulated 236 generated structures across 4 EC classes for a total of 59 μs, with 195/236 (82.6%) remaining consistently stable. All current evidence is computational, with no expression or enzyme activity validation.
en.audience: Researchers in protein language models, computational enzyme design and virtual screening
en.verification: DOI and abstract page verified; the final typeset version is still pending from the publisher, and correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Prophage landscapes in clinical MRSA: safety profiling and discovery of Lys81, a broad-spectrum bacteriolytic enzyme
items.cn: 从临床 MRSA 前噬菌体图谱发现广谱裂菌酶 Lys81
items.summary: 研究从大规模临床 MRSA 前噬菌体序列中筛出 N-乙酰胞壁酰-L-丙氨酸酰胺酶 Lys81，并完成体外活性、生物膜和肺类器官验证。
items.why: 它展示了从临床基因组资源、结构预测到酶学与疾病模型验证的一条完整酶发现路线。
items.evidence: 分析了 329 株 MRSA；Lys81 裂解 23/44 株临床金黄色葡萄球菌，在 50 μg/mL 下使 MRSA 生物膜减少 83%，并在肺类器官模型中报告了低细胞毒性和清除效果。
items.audience: 噬菌体酶、抗菌蛋白、酶挖掘与感染模型研究者
items.verification: Frontiers 原文页、DOI、日期与摘要数据已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: The study mines large-scale clinical MRSA prophage sequences to identify Lys81, an N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase, and validates it in vitro, on biofilms and in a lung organoid model.
en.why: It demonstrates a complete enzyme discovery route from clinical genomic resources through structure prediction to enzymology and disease-model validation.
en.evidence: 329 MRSA strains were analysed; Lys81 lysed 23/44 clinical Staphylococcus aureus strains, reduced MRSA biofilm by 83% at 50 μg/mL, and showed low cytotoxicity and clearance in a lung organoid model.
en.audience: Researchers in phage enzymes, antibacterial proteins, enzyme mining and infection models
en.verification: Frontiers source page, DOI, date and abstract data verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Proton Transport as a Missing Design Variable in Immobilized Enzyme Catalysis
items.cn: 固定化酶催化中被忽视的设计变量：界面质子传递
items.topic: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 文章提出，固定化载体不仅影响构象和扩散，还可能通过界面水结构与质子迁移改变碳酸酐酶等质子耦合酶的周转。
items.why: 它把载体润湿性和“表面质子天线”转化为可检验的设计变量，能启发固定化实验增加局部 pH 与质子传递对照。
items.evidence: 这是以碳酸酐酶为模型建立的机制观点与实验假说，并非已经证明的普遍规律；作者明确要求区分取向、构象、扩散、缓冲能力和产物积累等替代解释。
items.audience: 固定化、界面酶学、CO₂ 转化与材料酶学研究者
items.verification: Crossref/Wiley 注册元数据与摘要已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: The article proposes that immobilisation carriers affect not only conformation and diffusion but also turnover of proton-coupled enzymes such as carbonic anhydrase through interfacial water structure and proton migration.
en.why: It turns carrier wettability and "surface proton antennas" into testable design variables, which can prompt immobilisation experiments to add controls for local pH and proton transfer.
en.evidence: This is a mechanistic viewpoint and experimental hypothesis built on carbonic anhydrase as a model, not an established general rule; the authors explicitly ask for alternative explanations such as orientation, conformation, diffusion, buffering capacity and product accumulation to be separated.
en.audience: Researchers in immobilisation, interfacial enzymology, CO2 conversion and materials enzymology
en.verification: Crossref/Wiley registration metadata and abstract verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Nanosecond Pulsed Microwave Plasma Torch for Continuous In-Line H2O2 Supply: A Path to Stable and Scalable Plasma-Driven Biocatalysis
items.cn: 纳秒脉冲微波等离子体连续供给 H₂O₂，推动可控的过氧化物酶生物催化
items.topic: 酶催化方法与分析技术
items.summary: 研究将等离子体制备 H₂O₂ 与重组非特异性过氧化物酶反应空间解耦，实现连续辅底物供给并比较游离酶和固定化酶。
items.why: 真正可迁移的结论不是“等离子体更强”，而是连续体系必须匹配 H₂O₂ 生成速率与酶消耗速率，否则供给过量仍会导致失活。
items.evidence: 固定化 rAaeUPO 连续复用 5 个循环；空间解耦体系对乙苯转化获得较高周转数，但连续运行仍观察到 H₂O₂ 生成超过酶消耗造成的失活。
items.audience: 过氧化物酶、辅底物再生、连续流与反应器研究者
items.verification: Wiley/Chemistry Europe 页面、DOI、首发日期与摘要已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: The study decouples plasma-generated H2O2 from the reaction space of a recombinant unspecific peroxygenase, achieving continuous co-substrate supply and comparing free with immobilised enzyme.
en.why: The transferable conclusion is not that plasma is stronger but that a continuous system must match the H2O2 generation rate to the enzyme consumption rate, because over-supply still causes inactivation.
en.evidence: Immobilised rAaeUPO was reused for 5 consecutive cycles; the spatially decoupled system reached a high turnover number for ethylbenzene conversion, yet continuous operation still showed inactivation when H2O2 generation outpaced enzyme consumption.
en.audience: Researchers in peroxygenases, co-substrate regeneration, continuous flow and reactor design
en.verification: Wiley/Chemistry Europe page, DOI, first-published date and abstract verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Exploiting Biocatalysis for the Scalable Synthesis of Enantiopure γ-Hydroxynitrile Building Blocks
items.cn: 利用醇脱氢酶规模化合成对映纯 γ-羟基腈砌块
items.topic: 酶催化方法与分析技术
items.summary: 通过筛选互补选择性的醇脱氢酶，将 γ-酮腈还原为两种构型的 γ-羟基腈，并推进到克级制备。
items.why: 论文把酶筛选、选择性、工艺放大和绝对构型确认连接起来，是判断“可规模化生物催化”证据是否完整的清晰案例。
items.evidence: 目标产物最高收率 88%、对映体过量最高 99%；方法放大到 5 mmol 并获得克级产物，S 构型由单晶 X 射线衍射确认。
items.audience: 醇脱氢酶、手性合成、工艺开发与制备生物催化研究者
items.verification: Chemistry Europe Early View、DOI、日期与摘要已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: By screening alcohol dehydrogenases with complementary selectivity, γ-ketonitriles were reduced to both configurations of γ-hydroxynitrile and the route was pushed to gram-scale preparation.
en.why: The paper links enzyme screening, selectivity, process scale-up and absolute configuration assignment, making it a clear case for judging whether the evidence for scalable biocatalysis is complete.
en.evidence: The target products reached up to 88% yield and up to 99% enantiomeric excess; the method was scaled to 5 mmol with gram-scale product, and the S configuration was confirmed by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
en.audience: Researchers in alcohol dehydrogenases, chiral synthesis, process development and preparative biocatalysis
en.verification: Chemistry Europe Early View, DOI, date and abstract verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Enzyme@Silicone: A Versatile Combo for Robust Synthetic Biocatalysis?
items.cn: 酶与硅橡胶组合：面向稳健合成生物催化的固定化平台
items.topic: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 综述硅橡胶载体上的连接、包埋和复合固定化策略，以及其在有机相、多相和连续过程中的潜力。
items.why: 适合作为硅基聚合物固定化的专题入口，但仍需关注亲水底物传质、脂肪酶以外的证据稀缺和规模化问题。
items.evidence: 论文为综述性证据，汇总已有固定化案例，不提供单一新实验体系的直接验证。
items.audience: 聚合物载体、固定化与连续生物催化研究者
items.verification: Crossref/Wiley 注册元数据与摘要已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: A review of attachment, entrapment and composite immobilisation strategies on silicone carriers, and their potential in organic-phase, multiphase and continuous processes.
en.why: A useful topic entry point for silicone-based polymer immobilisation, though hydrophilic substrate mass transfer, the scarcity of evidence beyond lipases and scale-up questions still deserve attention.
en.evidence: The paper is review-level evidence that collects existing immobilisation cases and does not provide direct validation from a single new experimental system.
en.audience: Researchers in polymer carriers, immobilisation and continuous biocatalysis
en.verification: Crossref/Wiley registration metadata and abstract verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Advances in Enzyme Immobilization and Its Application in the Degradation of Typical Emerging Contaminants
items.cn: 固定化酶降解典型新兴污染物的进展与边界
items.topic: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 比较漆酶、过氧化物酶、过氧化氢酶和有机磷水解酶在多类载体上的固定化与污染物降解应用。
items.why: 它把 MOF、COF、磁性纳米材料、生物炭和碳材料放在同一评价框架中，也明确讨论传质、副产物毒性和放大难点。
items.evidence: 综述性证据；未来方向包括 AI 辅助载体设计和多酶催化体系，但这些仍属于展望而非已验证结论。
items.audience: 环境酶学、固定化载体与污染物生物修复研究者
items.verification: Crossref/Wiley 注册元数据与摘要已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: Compares immobilisation of laccases, peroxidases, catalases and organophosphorus hydrolases on multiple carrier types and their application to pollutant degradation.
en.why: It places MOFs, COFs, magnetic nanomaterials, biochar and carbon materials in one evaluation framework, and explicitly discusses mass transfer, by-product toxicity and scale-up difficulties.
en.evidence: Review-level evidence; future directions include AI-assisted carrier design and multi-enzyme systems, but these remain outlook rather than verified conclusions.
en.audience: Researchers in environmental enzymology, immobilisation carriers and pollutant bioremediation
en.verification: Crossref/Wiley registration metadata and abstract verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Unveiling the Physicochemical Properties of Magnetic Nanoparticles as Solid Carriers for Laccase Immobilization Toward Different Reducing Substrates
items.cn: 磁性纳米颗粒载体并非惰性：漆酶固定化中的表面反应性
items.topic: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 研究比较磁性纳米颗粒制备路线及漆酶的吸附和共价固定化，并发现载体表面会参与自由基相关过程。
items.why: 它提醒固定化研究不能默认载体完全惰性；表面反应性可能同时提高表观活性并吸附或改变反应产物。
items.evidence: 采用显微、光散射和光谱表征载体，并比较吸附与共价固定化；作者观察到少量 Fe²⁺ 条件下表面对漆酶反应产生的自由基具有较高反应性。
items.audience: 漆酶、磁性载体、自由基反应与固定化表征研究者
items.verification: DOI、MDPI/Crossref 元数据与摘要已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: The study compares magnetic nanoparticle preparation routes and adsorptive versus covalent laccase immobilisation, and finds that carrier surfaces take part in radical-related processes.
en.why: It warns that immobilisation studies cannot assume carriers are fully inert: surface reactivity may raise apparent activity while also adsorbing or altering reaction products.
en.evidence: Carriers were characterised by microscopy, light scattering and spectroscopy and adsorption versus covalent immobilisation compared; the authors observed that with traces of Fe2+ the surface is highly reactive towards radicals generated by the laccase reaction.
en.audience: Researchers in laccases, magnetic carriers, radical reactions and immobilisation characterisation
en.verification: DOI, MDPI/Crossref metadata and abstract verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

items.title: Bacterial ribonucleoprotein bodies maintain an acidic pH environment as a mechanism of enzyme regulation
items.cn: 细菌核糖核蛋白凝聚体以酸性微环境调控酶活
items.summary: 细菌 BR-bodies 形成约 pH 5.1 的酸性致密相，并通过这一局部化学环境改变 PNPase 活性。
items.why: 它把生物分子凝聚体从“空间共定位”推进到“局部 pH 调控酶活”的可测机制，对酶组装和细胞内催化都有启发。
items.evidence: 活细胞比率荧光探针、单分子定位和寿命成像共同支持酸性纳米环境；体外实验显示 PNPase 的最适 pH 为 5.3–6.3，静止期凝聚体约为 4.8 ± 0.2。
items.audience: 凝聚体、空间酶学、RNA 代谢与细胞内酶调控研究者
items.verification: Nature Communications 原文页、DOI、日期、摘要与来源数据入口已核验；更正/撤稿状态未独立审计。

en.summary: Bacterial BR-bodies form an acidic dense phase near pH 5.1 and modulate PNPase activity through that local chemical environment.
en.why: It advances biomolecular condensates from spatial co-localisation to a measurable mechanism of local pH control over enzyme activity, with implications for enzyme assembly and intracellular catalysis.
en.evidence: Live-cell ratiometric fluorescent probes, single-molecule localisation and lifetime imaging jointly support the acidic nano-environment; in vitro experiments show PNPase pH optimum of 5.3–6.3 and stationary-phase condensates near 4.8 ± 0.2.
en.audience: Researchers in condensates, spatial enzymology, RNA metabolism and intracellular enzyme regulation
en.verification: Nature Communications source page, DOI, date, abstract and source-data entry verified; correction/retraction status was not independently audited.

observationsEn: Immobilisation interfaces and process control were the clearest shared thread: proton transfer, carrier surface reactivity and hydrogen peroxide supply can all be hidden variables that decide enzyme performance.

The protein language model study completed molecular dynamics evaluation of 236 generated enzyme sequences, but there is still no expression, activity or substrate-profile experiment, so structural stability cannot be equated with functional success.

No new cascade assembly or fusion enzyme paper strong enough for the picks was found in this period; those sections remain and are carried by the classic reading path, rather than padding with weakly related papers.
